lines: The inside of your ankle is sore and swollen,

caption:
Toto went shopping for new runners and walked out worried about his flat feet.

Here's the thing: low arches are really common, and plenty of people with flat feet walk, run and play sport without trouble. Arch height on its own usually doesn't predict pain. If feet do hurt, orthotics or supportive shoes can help some people in the short term, but they're one option, not a must.

Hybi's foot routine: 15 calf raises × 2, 10 gentle arch lifts, 30 seconds of single-leg balance. Swap runners once they feel flat.

One foot that has recently flattened, or swelling on the inside of the ankle, is worth an assessment. Our Sydney CBD and Chatswood physios can help. Book online via the link in bio 🐰
